primary_rules: retain only GPS sensor type 653 rows requested by the frozen materializer
parse timestamp as UTC and preserve sub-second ordering
retain only rows whose Movebank visible flag is explicitly true after case-insensitive normalization
require finite longitude and latitude within [-180,180] and [-90,90]
collapse exact duplicate rows across all required raw columns and audit their count
if the same individual_id and timestamp occur with non-identical required raw fields, fail closed for that individual-year; do not choose one record
sort by individual_id then timestamp before movepp
do not interpolate, regularize, smooth, or resample locations before compute_step_speed
do not apply a post-hoc speed threshold or manual outlier filter beyond the source-managed Movebank visible flag
do not trim tracks to the three route regions before movepp phase segmentation
retain full calendar-year movement context; route-region assignment occurs only after automatic staging habitats are defined
invalid_coordinate_rule: fail closed if any visible=true GPS row has a nonfinite or out-of-range coordinate; do not silently drop
conflicting_duplicate_rule: fail closed and report identifiers/timestamps without choosing a row
missing_visible_rule: fail closed; the materializer requires the visible column
rationale: Movebank states that visible summarizes data-owner outlier management and recommends requesting it so flagged events can be excluded; fixing this before access prevents result-dependent track cleaning.
forbidden: no visual track cleaning after seeing cue-uptake results
no per-year tuning of cleaning rules
no replacement of visible=false filtering by a custom speed cutoff
